content.title: Active Shooter
content.summary: Active Shooter is a class that provides civilians with national protocols for responding to an armed perpetrator in public or private spaces. Interested individuals can request a class by calling 720-898-6883, with sessions scheduled based on enrollment levels.
content.body:
Active Shooter is a class that now serves as the national protocol for civilians on what to do when an armed perpetrator enters a public place or private business with the intent to kill.

For more information or to request a class please call 720-898-6883. Please note, classes will be scheduled upon request and conducted based on enrollment levels.
